title: FORGET
description:
Are you brave enough to go on a blind date with the big, bad, scary Lamb? What’s the worst that could happen? I steal your memories and leave you horny and denied? What a great idea! Here’s what’s going to happen. While we’re on our date, I’m going to snap my fingers and I am going to hypnotise you. While you’re hypnotized, I’m going to have my way with you. That means that I’ll be using your mind and your body to satisfy me. Part of a Hypno Collective collaboration. This is a deliciously long erotic hypnosis file, filled with layers of sound effects, layered audio, repetition, and countdowns designed to create mental overwhelm, narrowed focus, and increased suggestibility. Throughout the experience, suggestions are used to blur your sense of time, disrupt linear thinking, and create confusion about what’s happening. The file starts as a date… if you’re brave enough… but then shifts through overlapping segments, creating loops and a growing sense of disorientation. Memory play suggestions are used to encourage a feeling of forgetting or losing track of how you got there. Focus is gradually pulled away from thoughts and into sensation, building arousal through tease, denial, and guided interaction. By the end of the file, your awareness is dominated more by sensation and arousal than clear, structured thought. You may feel disoriented, worked up, and denied… with only a vague sense of how you got there, and a body that feels far more than your mind can clearly follow. How cruel. How mean. How perfect for a submissive like you. This file contains an abrupt wakener and post hypnotic suggestions. As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency
